citation.verbatim: Each record holder of common stock as of the close of market on Thursday, June 6, 2024 will receive nine additional shares of common stock, to be distributed after the close of market on Friday, June 7, 2024. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on Monday, June 10, 2024.

changes.what: NVDA June 2024 dividend net cash receivable

D1.decision: Process mandatory NVDA 10-for-1 forward split before the 2024-06-10 MEGA PCF dissemination using the 2024-06-06 record-date position. The correct NVDA basket quantity moves from 180 shares per creation unit pre-split to 1,800 shares per creation unit post-split; confirm custody at 180,000 shares post-distribution. No election or cash-in-lieu applies. Hold only the dependent net dividend receivable because withholding documentation is absent.
